profile.headline: Software engineer
profile.summary: I'm on an exciting journey to launch my career in the dynamic world of software engineering. With a passion for problem-solving and a deep curiosity for all things tech-related, I've embarked on this path to blend my creativity with coding skills. My journey so far has been filled with challenges, learning experiences, and a relentless drive to build innovative solutions. I'm eager to contribute my knowledge and collaborate with others to shape the digital landscape of the future. I'm excited to learn, and grow in the ever-evolving field of software engineering!

positions.title: Laboratory Technician
positions.description: This role involved a lot of data collection and analysis to identify trends and ensure consistency in the product and learned to work efficiently in a fast-paced production environment.
positions.insights: Food Processing, Food Manufacturing and +3 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer Internship
positions.description: I had the opportunity to wear many hats, from coding and debugging to collaborating with cross-functional teams. The fast-paced environment meant I had to adapt quickly, and I learned to juggle multiple tasks.
positions.insights: Agile Environment, Python (Programming Language) and +4 skills

positions.title: Photographer/Sales Associate
positions.description: I developed strong communication and interpersonal skills as I often interacted with customers to understand their vision and preferences.
positions.insights: Problem Solving and Passionate about Work
